$comment: The locales THIS repo translates into. Distinct from the front-end's
SUPPORTED_LOCALES (lib/locales.ts), which gates what is actually SERVED.
A locale can be translated here long before it is served, and a locale is
only ever added to SUPPORTED_LOCALES once its coverage here is complete.
`source` is not a target locale. It is the read-only English mirror, and
every script refuses to write to it. See CLAUDE.md.
